title: AI-Powered Dashboard
description: Real-time analytics dashboard with 3D data visualization
longDescription: A comprehensive analytics platform featuring interactive 3D charts, real-time data streaming, and AI-powered insights. Built with Next.js, React Three Fiber, and WebGL for optimal performance.

title: E-Commerce 3D Product Viewer
description: Interactive 3D product viewer with AR capabilities
longDescription: Revolutionary e-commerce experience allowing customers to view products in 3D and AR. Features include real-time customization, photorealistic rendering, and seamless checkout integration.

title: Portfolio Template Builder
longDescription: A drag-and-drop portfolio builder with 3D scene customization. Users can create stunning portfolios without coding knowledge, featuring customizable 3D environments and animations.

title: Virtual Event Platform
description: Immersive 3D virtual event space with networking
longDescription: A fully immersive virtual event platform featuring 3D environments, spatial audio, real-time video streaming, and interactive networking spaces. Supports thousands of concurrent users.

title: 3D Game Engine
description: Lightweight WebGL game engine for browser games
longDescription: A performant, modular game engine built on WebGL. Features include physics simulation, particle systems, skeletal animation, and a visual scene editor.

title: NFT Gallery Explorer
longDescription: An immersive 3D gallery experience for browsing NFT collections. Features include wallet integration, real-time market data, and customizable gallery layouts.
